name: JS Cursor Agent
description: Cursor CLI ACP runtime backend — manages long-lived Cursor agent acp processes with session pooling, permission auto-approval, and idle reclaim.

command.description: Path to the Cursor CLI agent command (default: agent)

idleTtlMinutes.description: Idle process reclaim timeout in minutes

command.label: Cursor Agent Command
command.help: Path/command for the Cursor CLI agent binary. Leave empty to use 'agent' from PATH.

authToken.label: Cursor Auth Token
authToken.help: Cursor auth token (alternative to API key).

defaultMode.label: Default Mode
defaultMode.help: Session mode: agent (full), plan (read-only planning), ask (questions only).

permissionMode.label: Permission Policy
permissionMode.help: How to auto-respond to Cursor tool permission requests.

idleTtlMinutes.label: Idle TTL (min)
idleTtlMinutes.help: Kill idle Cursor processes after this many minutes.

maxConcurrentSessions.label: Max Concurrent Sessions
maxConcurrentSessions.help: Maximum number of concurrent Cursor agent processes.
